nodes.author: hindustan_fit
nodes.text: 1/12 🚨 China is currently facing a surge in human metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases, raising alarms reminiscent of the #COVID_19 . Hospitals are reportedly overwhelmed, with patients suffering from various respiratory infections, including HMPV, Influenza A, and Mycoplasma pneumoniae https://t.co/yysgcLctT5

nodes.author: hindustan_fit
nodes.text: 2/12 🤒 What is HMPV? Human Metapneumovirus is a respiratory virus that can cause flu-like symptoms, primarily affecting children and vulnerable populations. Symptoms include cough, fever, nasal congestion, and in severe cases, bronchitis or pneumonia. https://t.co/hffd1eGr9R

nodes.author: hindustan_fit
nodes.text: 3/12 📈 The outbreak has led to reports of congested hospitals across northern China. While some social media posts claim a state of emergency has been declared, there has been no official confirmation from health authorities or the WHO. https://t.co/KyKTWtxeSQ

nodes.author: hindustan_fit
nodes.text: 4/12 🌍 Global Concerns: The rapid spread of HMPV in China could have significant implications worldwide. Given the interconnected nature of global travel, uncontrolled outbreaks can lead to increased cases in other countries just like #COVID_19 https://t.co/DXyb0BviRN

nodes.author: hindustan_fit
nodes.text: 5/12 ⚠️ Health experts are particularly worried about co-infections. The simultaneous presence of multiple viruses can complicate treatment and increase the risk of severe illness, especially among children and the elderly. https://t.co/aAM3bX4ZCp

nodes.author: hindustan_fit
nodes.text:
6/12 🦠 How does HMPV spread? Similar to other respiratory viruses, HMPV spreads through respiratory droplets from coughing and sneezing, close personal contact, and touching contaminated surfaces.
https://t.co/JEdDSO01WV

nodes.author: hindustan_fit
nodes.text: 7/12 🔍 The current surge is believed to be exacerbated by the lifting of COVID-19 restrictions. Many people have had reduced exposure to respiratory pathogens during lockdowns, leading to increased susceptibility as social interactions resume. https://t.co/iKTNqh20Hr
